correctness.rationale: Checked all boundary terms n=0,1,2 and k=0. Greedy arch scanning is bidirectionally exact: each completed arch realizes a target letter, and concatenating each arch-closing bit with a missing suffix bit yields a forbidden target length r+1. The exhaustive three-state equations P=2z+zE, Q=z(P+E), E=uz(P+Q) produce the rational bivariate function and finite binomial coefficient formula. Dominant root of 1-e^t(2z^2+z^3)=0 is simple/isolated since gcd(2,3)=1; differentiating its implicit equation gives n/sqrt5 mean and variance coefficient 1-11sqrt5/25>0, with analytic quasi-power CLT. Reimplemented exhaustive definition-level subsequence checking through n=11 matches coefficients; no finite test is used to prove the asymptotic.
